cover.title: Cover Node
cover.content:
A story pack may only contain one Cover Node. It contains the image and audio that are played by the Story Teller when the user is choosing a story pack.

Allowed actions:

  • () WHEEL: to go through the list of story packs
  • () OK: to transition to the first actual node of the story pack.

menu.title: Menu Node
menu.content:
A Menu Node can be used to ask a question to the user, and offer them a list of options to choose from. Each option can transition to a different node, be it a Story Node, another Menu Node, or even an Action Node.

Allowed actions during question:

  • () AUTOPLAY: to transition to the first option after the question is played

Allowed actions on options:

  • () WHEEL: to select another option
  • () OK: to transition to the next node, depending on the selected option
  • () HOME: to go back to the previous node (if only one node leads to this Menu Node) or to go back to the pack-selection node (the diagram entry point)

BE CAREFUL: the HOME transition may vary depending on the number of links leading to this Menu Node.

story.title: Story Node
story.content:
A Story Node only plays audio, and automatically goes back to the start of the story pack when done playing.

Allowed actions:

  • () AUTOPLAY: to transition back to the start of the story pack after the audio is played
  • () PAUSE: to pause and resume the playback
  • () HOME: to manually transition back to the start of the story pack

BE CAREFUL: the AUTOPLAY and HOME transitions go back to the first useful node of the pack, which is the node following the entry point. Thus, YOU SHOULD NOT HAVE A SINGLE STORY NODE RIGHT AFTER THE COVER NODE.

You can customize the behaviour of a Story Node:

  • By overriding the AUTOPLAY transition
  • By overriding the HOME transition (leaving an empty HOME transition will go back to the entry point)
  • By disabling the HOME button altogether

stage.title: Stage Node
stage.content:
A Stage Node can play an audio file and/or display an image. There are a few settings you can toggle to control what the user can or cannot do:

  • () Allow WHEEL selection: whether the user can or cannot navigate the current "menu" / Action Node's list (you may want to disable this when playing a question or a story)
  • () Allow OK button: whether the user can press OK (you may want to disable this when playing a question or a story)
  • () Allow HOME button: whether the user can press HOME (you may want to disable this when playing a question). Leaving an empty HOME transition will go back to the entry point.
  • () Allow PAUSE button: whether the user can press PAUSE (you may want to enable this when playing a story)
  • () Enable AUTOPLAY: whether the Story Teller should automatically play the OK transition when the audio file is done playing (you may want to enable this when playing a question or a story)

BE CAREFUL: Stage and action nodes are closely tied to the file format understood by the Story Teller. These nodes are not very intuitive to work with, but give you the most flexibility. Be sure to know what you are doing or you may shoot yourself in the foot.

action.title: Action Node
action.content:
An Action Node is simply a list of items, each item pointing to a Stage Node. It may be used to create a "menu" from which the user can choose an option (when the wheel is enabled), or as a repository of stories or questions to play, or simply to transition from a Stage Node to another.

BE CAREFUL: Stage and action nodes are closely tied to the file format understood by the Story Teller. These nodes are not very intuitive to work with, but give you the most flexibility. Be sure to know what you are doing or you may shoot yourself in the foot.

diagram.title: Diagram and Assets
diagram.content:
The diagram represents a story pack, starting from an entry point and defining how the user can navigate between nodes. Here are a few notable things:

  • The entry point of the story pack / diagram may be either a Cover Node or a Stage Node
  • When using Expert Nodes, you can chain Stage Nodes and Action Nodes however you like, but keep in mind the "golden rule": a Stage Node can only transition to an Action Node, and an Action Node contains a list of Stage Nodes only.
  • You can mix and match expert nodes with simplified nodes if you see fit. The editor got your back and won't let you make invalid links that do not follow the "golden rule".

Image assets must follow a few requirements:

  • Supported formats are BMP (24-bits), PNG** (without alpha layer) and JPEG** (formats marked with asterisks are automatically converted when transferring to the device)
  • Image dimensions must be 320x240 (any other image the browser can read, e.g. JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF of any size, is converted automatically when added, keeping its proportions with black bands)
  • Images may use colors, even though some colors may not render accurately due to the screen being behind the plastic cover. Bear in mind that the color of the cover may change, as seen with the recently released Christmas edition.

Audio assets must follow a few requirements:

  • Supported formats are WAVE (signed 16-bits, mono, 32000 Hz), MP3** (44100 Hz) and OGG/Vorbis** (44100 Hz) (formats marked with asterisks are automatically converted when transferring to the device)
  • For better playback, audio files should include short blanks (around 400 ms for short sounds, a few seconds for long stories) at the beginning and end of file.
  • Audio levels should be pretty high. Aim for peak level around -3dB or higher, and mean RMS around -20dB.

askAllowEnriched.title: Enable enriched binary format?
askAllowEnriched.content:
The so-called enriched binary format leverages empty spaces within binary packs to store metadata (pack's title and description, as well each node's type, name and position).

This avoids loss of information (except for the pack thumbnail) and the pack can be converted back to archive format, then opened in the editor with all information intact (although potentially truncated).

However, this is a deviation from the original / official pack format understood by the device, and the packs may not be read correctly at some point.

You will be able to change this behaviour in the Settings panel.

Do you want to enable the enriched binary format (select No if you prefer to stick to the original / official format for maximum compatibility)?

askConfirmConversion.title: Convert story pack?
askConfirmConversion.content:
A device-compatible instance of this story pack is already in the library, but STUdio cannot check that it was produced from the pack the library holds now — so it may not match.

Convert that pack again to be sure, or send the existing instance if you know it is the one you want.

(The converted pack will be stored in the local library)
askConfirmConversion.contentMismatch:
A device-compatible instance of this story pack is already in the library, but STUdio has checked it: it was not made from the pack the library holds now, so it would not send what you have.

Convert that pack again, or send the existing instance anyway if that is what you want.

(The converted pack will be stored in the local library)

deviceRepair.noProblem: No problem: the Lunii's index and folders are consistent ({{count}} story).
deviceRepair.noProblem_plural: No problem: the Lunii's index and folders are consistent ({{count}} stories).

offer.text: Checking the Lunii can resolve this.

pendingIndex.title: Interrupted index write (.pi.new)

kinds.TORN: A new index started being written and was interrupted: it is incomplete or empty.
kinds.IDENTICAL: The pending index is identical to the installed one.
kinds.ADD_INCOMPLETE: The pending index added a story whose copy did not finish.
kinds.REMOVE: The pending index removes {{removed}} story(ies): a removal was interrupted.
kinds.REORDER: The pending index lists the same stories in another order: a reordering was interrupted.
kinds.OTHER: The pending index differs from the installed one ({{current}} installed, {{pending}} pending; {{added}} added, {{removed}} removed).

pendingIndex.safe: Removing it loses nothing: the Lunii keeps using its current index. While it is there, no story can be added, removed or reordered.
pendingIndex.confirmDiscard: Remove the .pi.new file? The Lunii's current index stays as it is.
pendingIndex.choice: STUdio cannot decide on its own: choose which index the Lunii keeps.
pendingIndex.confirmKeep: Keep the current index and remove the pending file?
pendingIndex.confirmAdopt: Replace the current index by the new one?

keepMeans.ADD: The added stories will not show on the Lunii; their folders stay on the card (orphan folders). Do not remove them if you may want them back.
keepMeans.REMOVE: The removed stories stay on the Lunii, as before the removal.
keepMeans.REORDER: The Lunii keeps the previous order.
keepMeans.OTHER: The Lunii keeps the list of stories it uses today.

adoptMeans.ADD: The added stories show on the Lunii, at the end of the list.
adoptMeans.REMOVE: The removed stories disappear from the Lunii's list; their folders stay on the card, and the current index is kept as .pi.bak.
adoptMeans.REORDER: The Lunii adopts the new order.
adoptMeans.OTHER: The Lunii uses the new list; the current index is kept as .pi.bak.

pendingIndex.cannotAdopt: The pending index cannot be adopted: it names {{count}} story(ies) whose folder is not a complete copy on the Lunii. Only the current index can be kept.
pendingIndex.confirmAdoptRemoving: Replace the current index by the new one? These stories will no longer be listed on the Lunii: {{titles}}. Their folders stay on the card, and the current index is kept as .pi.bak.

states.COPY_INTERRUPTED: {{folder}}: an unfinished update copy was left next to the story, whose folder is complete.
states.PROMOTE_NEW: {{folder}}: the story's folder is incomplete, but a complete copy of the new version is there.
states.SWAP_INTERRUPTED: {{folder}}: interrupted while switching; the story's folder is missing, the new version is complete.
states.CLEANUP_INTERRUPTED: {{folder}}: the new version is in place; the previous one was not completely removed.
states.RESTORE_PREVIOUS: {{folder}}: the story's folder is incomplete, but the previous version, complete, is there.
states.PREVIOUS_ONLY: {{folder}}: the story's folder is missing; the previous version is left, under a temporary name.
states.NEW_ONLY: {{folder}}: the story's folder is missing; only a complete copy of the new version is left.
states.ABANDONED_COPY: {{folder}}: the story's folder is missing and the only copy left is unfinished: it cannot be used.
states.CONFLICT: {{folder}}: several copies of this story are there, or none is complete, and STUdio cannot tell safely which one to keep. Nothing is changed: leave the folders as they are and check the card (disk check tool).
states.UNREFERENCED: {{folder}}: leftovers of an update of a story no longer on the Lunii.

actions.PROMOTE_NEW: Put the complete copy in place

confirm.COPY_INTERRUPTED: Remove the unfinished copy of {{folder}}? STUdio first checks the integrity of the story in place, and removes nothing if it is not intact.
confirm.PROMOTE_NEW: Put the complete copy of {{folder}} in place of the incomplete folder? Only the incomplete folder is removed.
confirm.SWAP_INTERRUPTED: Put the new version of {{folder}} in place (one rename), then remove the previous one? If the new one fails the integrity check, the previous one is put back and nothing is removed.
confirm.CLEANUP_INTERRUPTED: Remove the previous version of {{folder}}? STUdio first checks the integrity of the new one, and removes nothing if it is not intact.
confirm.RESTORE_PREVIOUS: Put the previous version of {{folder}} back in place of the incomplete folder? Only the incomplete folder is removed.
confirm.PREVIOUS_ONLY: Put the previous version of {{folder}} back in place (one rename)?
confirm.NEW_ONLY: Put the copy of {{folder}} in place (one rename)?
confirm.ABANDONED_COPY: Remove the unfinished copy of {{folder}}? The story will have no content: send it again afterwards.
confirm.UNREFERENCED: Tidy up the leftovers of {{folder}}? Unfinished copies are removed; a complete copy is put back under the name {{folder}} (it then shows as an orphan folder) and is not removed.

orphans.title: Orphan folders
orphans.intro: Story folders the Lunii's index does not reference (interrupted copy or removal): they take up space and can block sending the same story again. A complete copy may be the only copy of a story: remove it only if you no longer need it.
orphans.confirm: Permanently remove this folder from the Lunii?
orphans.confirm_plural: Permanently remove these {{count}} folders from the Lunii?
orphans.pending: named by the pending index: resolve it first

missing.title: Stories listed without content
missing.confirm: Remove this story from the Lunii's index? STUdio first checks that its content is still missing; you can send it again afterwards.

integrity.title: Story integrity
integrity.intro: Reads the indexes and the header of every image and sound, writing nothing on the Lunii. May take a while on a full Lunii.

codes.ASSET_INDEX_INVALID: Image or sound index (ri/si) invalid, or not deciphering with this Lunii's key
codes.COUNT_MISMATCH: Counts in ni and ri/si do not match
codes.ASSET_REFERENCE_OUT_OF_RANGE: A node refers to an image or sound that does not exist
codes.TRANSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE: A menu or transition leads to a node that does not exist
codes.ASSET_HEADER_INVALID: Ciphered header that does not decipher with this Lunii's key
codes.BOOT_FILE_INVALID: Boot file (bt) not made for this Lunii

integrity.official: Official story: reinstall it from the Luniistore.
integrity.notInLibrary: This story is not in the library: it cannot be sent again from here.
integrity.folderMissing: This story's folder is missing: remove it from the index ("Stories listed without content"), then send it again.
integrity.structureOnly: Official story: only the files and the structure are checked, as its ciphered parts may use a key of their own.
integrity.confirmResend: Send "{{title}}" again from the library? The Lunii's version (v{{device}}) is replaced by the library's (v{{library}}), in the same place.
integrity.confirmResendNoVersion: Send "{{title}}" again from the library? The Lunii's version is replaced by the library's, in the same place.
integrity.resendStarted: Sending started: follow it in the notifications.

refusal.title: Not enough space on the Lunii
refusal.content: This pack will take about {{required}} once in the Lunii's format, but it only has {{free}} free: {{missing}} short.
refusal.content_plural: These {{count}} packs will take about {{required}} once in the Lunii's format, but it only has {{free}} free: {{missing}} short.
refusal.explain: Nothing was converted nor sent. Free some space by removing stories from the Lunii, or send fewer packs at a time. The estimate counts the conversion (MP3 and images for recent Lunii, WAV for the first Lunii) and the minimum space each file takes on the card.
refusal.sendAnywayExplain: The free space seems too small, but going by a high estimate: it may still fit. "Send anyway" tries the transfer; if it really does not fit, the Lunii will refuse it by itself.
